title: ExtractionCompletedEvent
description: Published by the worker on the extraction-results topic once a job succeeds or fails for good. message_id is "{doc_id}:{status}"; application properties: tenant_id, doc_id, status. A missing completed_at means "now" to readers.

result_blob_url.description: extraction-results/{tenant_id}/{doc_id}.json for a succeeded event; null for a failed one.

error.description: The reason, for a failed event.
